newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Georgia plans to lease Airbus planes.
newsitem.headline: Georgia plans to lease Airbus planes.

text.p: Georgia plans to lease two A-310 passenger jets and two smaller planes from Airbus Industrie, a senior aviation official said on Friday.
Zurab Chankotadze, the head of civil aviation Georgian agency, told Reuters that a leasing agreement would be signed in April.
"All these planes will be operated by a new state-owned carrier -- Sakartvelos Aviakhazebi (Airlines of Georgia)," he said.
Georgia has set up the new state carrier this week and said it would begin operations in July.
Chankotadze did not give details of the lease payment conditions, but said Georgia made the decision to lease from Airbus after considering leasing jets from rival Boeing.
